notes.title: Skirmish with the Chanyu
notes.content:
[h1]Skirmish with the Chanyu[/h1]
The player has a number of options  to command his warriors. He can command each warrior singularly or as a squad. The player can create multiple squads and command those separately.

[previewyoutube=LIE4qwkxChI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Side Menus[/h3]
The side menu is a quick visual menu to issue commands to a warrior or squad
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/676bf0a160a617e1d13902effe0237e8ea7cf715.jpg[/img]

[h3]Main Warrior Menus[/h3]
The main warrior menu is more in depth and provides additional detail on each warrior. Commands are issued through the drop down box.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/a1407ff39f574027d4e13169eb9f0966a11c7459.png[/img]

[h3]Create Squads and Missions[/h3]
Missions can be assigned to warriors or squads. Squads can also be created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/a131ef28bee330d3cac09f869dc053e73e48e25c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Swordsmen and Crossbowmen[/h3]
The crossbowmen will tend to keep a little distance between themselves and the enemy whilst the swordsmen warriors will confront any enemy.

notes.title: Ox and Cart : Transport Lifeblood
notes.content:
[h1]Ox and Cart[/h1]
[u][b]Transport[/b][/u]
Use the cart to transport various types of resources :
[list]
[*] Live animals, chickens and pigs
[*] Dead animals, such as chickens, pigs and deer killed on a hunt
[*] Goods such as barrels of food
[*] Dead bodies
[/list]
Captured resources and adding to the food larder of a village is a great way to help moral and improve work productivity:
[list]
[*] transfer resources between friendly villages if they have that resource available however taking from one village to help another village may be counter productive if the village is left short of resources
[*] evaluate and balance other factors before making decisions
[/list]
Taking pigs to another village:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/9c40197976910f22a6adeefd9682e3c2e598a31c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/cb6670bcf13f7200a423b2fc0f6b05ec2683d36e.jpg[/img]

Transporting chickens:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/cf26d48eae5e63e429e9507156529b066d29267b.jpg[/img]

[u][b]The Cart Driver[/b][/u]
The cart driver is a specialist peasant who has the skills to handle the cart. The peasant walks with the cart and actions your commands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/b921d67585582713263f82ec0eed429b9baabe02.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Conversation[/b][/u]
Conversations with the AI are dynamic and the peasants will respond to you based on your questions and what they are doing. 

If you meet the same peasant and ask the same question at different times you may get different but relevant responses. 

For example asking a cart driver a question could result in different replies based on what they are doing:
[list]
[*] is he going to collect his ox and cart
[*] has goods in his cart and is going somewhere
[*] is he returning from a delivery
[*] obeying a command such as joining a patrol
[*] has something in his memory
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/44aa096d01fad181c3a8f03e6669c9415df8440c.png[/img]

[u][b]Patrols[/b][/u]
The game map has been updated although not yet complete (no enemy territory as yet). 

You can now create patrols and set a route for the warriors to take. Waypoint markers (red pins) can be set so the patrol performs a specific task when they reach them. 

As patrols have an estimated time to complete you can see an estimate as to their progress on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/57e42734793850fc1e9cdba07df65f7d33e4ec8e.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Events[/b][/u]
The peasant event manager has been updated to better reflect the events a peasant or warrior sees.

You can order a patrol to directly investigate an event.  Dead bodies probably indicate enemy activity so it may be worth sending a patrol to investigate ... or take some warriors and go and investigate for yourself.

This image of the map shows the location of dead bodies, where a warrior was seen, a cart and deer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/dab7ea05f3c94d202a96773fb60dcfa5958b8033.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Map and Memories
notes.content:
[h1]
Notification of a Significant Event[/h1]
As in real life as a player you wont find out about events unless your patrols report back, peasants trust you and are willing to speak or unless you ask however if the peasant has aggressive intent or a bad attitude then you may not always get a truthful response.

The memory manager displays significant events that can be filtered by type and time of occurrence so they can be investigated by the player or a patrol.

Where information is relayed to the player the information is saved in the players memory and can be displayed on the game map. The player can then issue commands directly by hovering the mouse over a pin on the map.

[i][b]NOTE : this is an incomplete version of the game map as the game environment is still under development[/b][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/08649940adae12c12e1f21e2bcfcc64198b8b7dd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Player Questions and Automatic Actions[/h1]
The questions the player asks and any automatic responses required such as a threat by the player to the peasant or village are handled by the Character Interaction Engine. The conversations, responses and consequences can all be customised by the player to affect game play.

[b][i]The player asking a peasant a question, these questions, responses and any required actions can be customised
[/i][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/3bd5201c5285052597aa4364465001e60234c369.jpg[/img]

[h1]AI Responses Saved in Players Memory[/h1]
Conversations are saved so the player can make decisions based on the information given. Unhelpful peasants can be punished ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/6617e16a5a73a6ac7c2a314617307cb57de5e993.jpg[/img]
[h1]
Responses to an Event[/h1]
Missions are created if the player wants to order a response to an event, such as send a squad of warriors to investigate a sighting of enemy Chanyu or if a dead body was found. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/a3e62ce1473ec3da04f31ce8df4affaced3f474f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Memories[/h1]
There are a number of various event types such as  :
[list]
[*] see a dead body
[*] enemy sighted
[*] see animals such as deer
[*] sight a warrior patrol
[*] meet the player
[*] sight an ox and cart
[/list]

notes.title: Customise the Game through Character Interactions and Responses
notes.content:
We are creating an ability for you to create custom versions of the game through text files that allow you to upload and share custom games. 

Our character interaction system creates character interactions, conversations, responses and event consequences that respond to situations and events from text files which you can customise.

The text files can be created through spreadsheets and impact :
[list]
[*] character to character
[*] character to player
[*] player to character
[*] word of mouth
[*] characters attitude and how they respond and act e.g. lie or become aggressive
[*] responses to significant events
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35662810/3a9b7ddd1b47be169418d901d89ec7fbd0581414.jpg[/img]
